descriptions.zh:
我们必须履行承诺。[owner.GetName]子民们指望我们在未来40年内进入太空帝国的阶段。我们必须努力通过§G控制恒星系§!、§G殖民行星§!来扩张国家，如果遇到其他帝国则还需要§G签订防御条约§!。

§G40年§!之后，我们每取得§G15点进度§!，我们的统治者§H光耀者特质§!就会得到进一步强化。
descriptions.en:
We must deliver on our promises. [owner.GetName] citizens are counting on us to grow into a spacefaring empire in the coming 40 years. We should strive to expand our nation by §Gcontrolling systems§!, §Gcolonizing planets§!, and - if we encounter other empires - §Gsigning defense pacts§!.

After §G40 years§!, our Ruler's §HLuminary Trait§! will improve for every §G15 points§! of progress we've made.

descriptions.zh:
§Y凯德斯§!发来的一份正式请求，希望验证他的幻视是否是真实有意义的。

如果同意就有可能解锁他的过去和与他一同找到的神秘遗物的秘密。
descriptions.en:
A formal request from §YKeides§! to prove or disprove the validity of his visions.

Doing so may well unlock the key to his past and the mysterious relic he was found with.
